description: Declare a shipped order as delivered (no carrier confirmation is wired). Only valid from shipped; already-delivered is a no-op success. Notifies the buyer, who can dispute if it never arrived. Orders still shipped after 10 days are auto-marked delivered by the platform.

order_id.description: UUID of the shipped order to declare delivered. Already-delivered is a no-op success.
